base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.role: development only; consumed real arrival seeds
protocol.single_change: successor class priority q_i/mu_i becomes q_i*nu_i; nu_i=lanes*max(pure batch/effective duration), fixed independently of queue and samples
protocol.successors: choose nonempty class by priority, tie by coordinate, then unchanged largest fitting pure batch and maximal lane copies; two successors per contender
protocol.unchanged: raw Poisson current search, support cap, paid pool, recovery, single shared path and horizon, first frame, original-mu fluid tail, final candidate tie break
protocol.sampling: aligned-planning:{planning_seed}:{coordinate}; caller-owned streams advance only on active calls; trajectories may diverge after changed decisions
protocol.cost: same root plus four paid successor attempts; static pure-profile rates computed once per active comparison; profile/rate evaluations reported separately; priority-coordinate count is a subtotal of class evaluations
protocol.controls: v4 36 and analytic 36 plus Poisson 108; reproduce all 180 frozen runs and deterministic counters
protocol.pairing: same load, real seed, budget, planning seed; mean of per-run ratios across planning seeds within real seed, then across real seeds

frozen_state_diagnostic.rng: aligned-cv-continuation:{sample_index}:{coordinate}, same samples as frozen raw margins
frozen_state_diagnostic.target: same fixed contender pairs and old single-action effects under common v4 continuation; all states and occurrences, no new replays
frozen_state_diagnostic.measure: within-state pressure/raw fixed-margin means, paired changes and MCSE; compare oriented means to frozen actual effects
frozen_state_diagnostic.cost: charge every diagnostic search, draw, rate setup and class evaluation separately from the online budget

protocol.stopping_rule: 288 full runs once and all 63 frozen states with 64 samples; no coefficients, seed additions, outcome filters or post-result changes

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

frozen_state_diagnostic.sample_margin_sign: fixed analytic challenger minus support incumbent
limitations: Targets reuse consumed development trajectories, with overlapping futures and repeated states; case counts are occurrences, not independent replicates or whole-policy effects.
Changing successor priority changes the fixed-action proxy expectation. Variance ratios and paired Monte Carlo standard errors are descriptive, with sample ids crossed across states.
Realized-minus-proxy residuals mix arrival-tape noise, horizon cutoff, and hybrid-model versus v4 continuation; they do not identify pure model bias.
All new searches, path draws and pressure preparation are charged. Native totals include separately reported coordinate subcounts; frozen target-replay work is reused and not charged as new work.
Static homogeneous throughput pressure is a parameter-free continuation heuristic; it does not equal v4 joint-action selection on finite queues.
Only two successor frames are discrete; the fluid tail and one-sample final comparison remain approximations.

Full runs reuse development arrival seeds with crossed planning repetitions. Frozen diagnostic states were selected from earlier raw/CV disagreements, and their overlapping intervention effects are not independent policy outcomes.
Pressure changes the proxy expectation. Diagnostic target residuals still mix arrival noise, horizon cutoff and continuation differences; execution PASS does not require better performance.
